6743043894.name: mono - Share the Joy of New Finds
6743043894.description:
mono - An app for sharing the joy of welcoming new things home
mono is an app that lets you share your encounters with things, and the moment you bring them home, not just with yourself but with everyone.
By posting your everyday favorites and the collections you're proud of, you share that joy with other users and build a community.
By sharing the items you've "welcomed home" with other users, you can do more than just own things: you can cherish and enjoy the background and stories behind them.
Concept
Our lives are surrounded by things every day. Clothes, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, stuffed animals, ornaments, and all sorts of other items add color to our lives. These items are not merely material objects; they carry emotions, memories, and even stories. mono treats this "welcoming home" of things as something special and provides a platform for sharing it with others.
Under the theme "Keep the joy of the moment you welcome something home, in photos and feelings," this app lets users share and enjoy with one another the excitement and joy that come from meeting new things.
mono aims not just for showing things off to each other, but for cherishing their background and stories and making the time spent with them richer.
Main features
Welcome-home posts
A feature for easily posting items you've newly brought home. Along with photos, you can share the item's name, features, where you bought it, and its story. Sharing the feelings and attention to detail you put into an item leads to deeper connections with other users.
Keep photos and stories
Photograph an item and post it with the stories and episodes that go with it. A souvenir bought on a trip, memories of a present from a friend, an item you welcomed home on a special day: you can convey not just the object, but the emotions behind it.
Favorite things corner
You can create a corner that gathers your most beloved items and show it to other users. In this corner, you can add a message along with photos that tells how much each item means to you.
Follow & comment
Follow other users to keep up with the items and posts that interest you. You can also use comments to share your impressions of, and empathy for, items others have welcomed home, and enjoy deeper interactions.
"Today's welcome" feed
A feed for sharing the items you welcomed home today, right away. By looking at other users' "Today's welcome," you can discover trends and new items and connect with people who share your hobbies.
Hashtag search
You can sort posts with hashtags like #WelcomedItems, #FavoriteItems, #Favorites, and #Matching. This makes it easy to search for posts about specific items or themes and share common interests with more people.
Stories for each item
For each item, you can keep a story about how you met it, what made you buy it, and what you thought after using it. This lets users not only show things to each other but also share the meaning and feelings they put into them, and find empathy.
Target audience
mono is developed for everyone who values their encounters with things and wants to share that joy and excitement. It especially targets women, and is ideal for people who enjoy sharing the things they treasure and their favorite items from daily life.
- People interested in fashion or interior design
- People who are proud of their collections
- People who treasure their memories
- People who keep up with new items and trends
- People who want to share their lifestyle with others
For these users, mono is a great fit as an app that offers heartwarming moments.
Design
The app uses a simple, refined, and beautiful design. Item photos take center stage, and to bring out their beauty, the background is based on calm pastel colors. The visually pleasant design lets users use the app comfortably and focus on the items that have been posted.
The user interface (UI) is also designed to be intuitive and easy to use, so even beginners can get started right away. It's a place to show each other the things you've welcomed home.
In closing
mono is a community app that values not just owning things, but your encounters with them, how they grow with you, and your attachment to them. While enjoying the memories of the items you've welcomed home and your connections with other users, you can make new discoveries and find empathy.
"Keep the joy of the moment you welcome something home, in photos and feelings": that is the essence of mono. Why not share the wonderful time you spend with your things, and connect over it with others?

- Gold Mole: reads your gaze and pops up in your blind spot. Short-lived, big points.

That one line is the whole song.

Bytebeat turns a formula straight into sound. It evaluates your expression while t counts up from zero, one step at a time, and writes the result out as the waveform. No synthesizer, no audio files, no samples. The formula is the music.

■ Edit while it plays
- Rewrite the formula without stopping playback. t keeps running
- Change a single character and the song becomes something else
- A keypad holding only the characters that appear in bytebeat formulas, so one tap is one character

■ See the waveform
- An oscilloscope draws the samples that are actually playing
- Traces are aligned to the rising edge, so the wave stays still instead of scrolling
- Instruction count and stack depth are shown too

■ 29 famous formulas
- Includes the one-liners from the experiments viznut published in 2011
- Save the ones you like to favorites with your own names

■ Three modes
- Bytebeat: result & 255 mapped to 0...255, the way the original sounded
- Signed: treated as signed 8-bit
- Floatbeat: the result used directly as a -1...1 waveform, where sin and cos come alive

■ Change the speed of t
- 500 to 48000 Hz. The original bytebeat ran at 8000 Hz
- Slower runs lower, faster runs higher

■ Export to WAV
- 8-bit, 8000 Hz, mono, which is exactly what bytebeat is
- 10 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute or 3 minutes

■ What you can write
- The variable t, and the constants PI and E
- Arithmetic, bitwise operators, shifts, comparison, logic, the ternary operator
- sin cos tan asin acos atan abs floor ceil round sqrt exp log sign int pow min max atan2 mod
- Everything is computed in Double and rounded to 32-bit integers only for bitwise operations and shifts. This matches JavaScript's ToInt32, so formulas you find on the web play as they are

■ No connection
- No account to create
- No ads, no tracking
- The app never connects to the internet. It works on a plane

Many of the presets come from the experiments Ville-Matias Heikkila (viznut) published in 2011.

6799612767.name: Beetle Wars
6799612767.description:
Rhinoceros beetles and stag beetles clash horn to horn.

Win rock-paper-scissors and you get to attack. Simple to start, deep to master.

■ Ten seconds that decide the match
Rock, scissors, paper. The skill card you set on the winning hand fires.
Which skill you assign to which hand IS your strategy.
On a draw, both beetles push horns and trade recoil damage that grows with each
consecutive draw, so you have to decide whether to hold or back off.

■ The beetles fight while you choose
During those ten seconds the two lock horns and shove. Front legs scrabble at the
ground, hind legs brace. The build-up is the best part.

■ Collect and raise 20 real species
Hercules beetle, Giraffe stag beetle, Rainbow stag beetle and more.
Each has its scientific name, body length, range and notes in the encyclopedia.
Individuals vary in size, so hunting for a big one is its own reward.
Every species is modelled in 3D, and their horns and jaws move differently.

■ Favoured hands
Each beetle has a hand it is good at. Winning with that hand deals 1.2x damage.
You can see the foe's favoured hand before and during the battle, so you can
read what they are likely to throw.

■ Hard mode, once you are done
Clear every Normal chapter and Hard opens on the same 20 stages.
Enemy levels and skill cards jump; the last foe is a Lv 90 beetle with Lv 20 cards.
Coins and EXP are 2.5x, and first-clear jewels are doubled.

■ Battle someone nearby (iPhone / iPad)
Play against a person on Bluetooth or the same network, right where you are.
If nobody is nearby, you can battle an opponent built on your device instead.

■ Buy once, play forever
No in-app purchases. No ads. No account or sign-up.
Jewels and upgrade materials are earned by playing, and nothing else.
Your save stays on this device and is never sent anywhere.

■ Game Center (optional)
Leaderboards for arena points, stages cleared and species logged, plus 7 achievements.
Signing in is optional; the whole game is playable without it.

6823032334.name: Tap Here: Phone Help with AI
6823032334.description:
"Where do I tap next?"
When you get stuck on your phone, just show a screenshot of that screen. Tap Here marks the place to tap with a red circle, a number, and an arrow.

Ask before you tap.
No more trying to explain "the gear icon at the top right…" over the phone.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Take a screenshot of the screen you are stuck on
2. Choose that screenshot in this app
3. Tap where the red circle is
You can also write what you want to do, such as "I want bigger text", for more detailed steps.

ONE STEP AT A TIME, READ ALOUD
- Steps are shown one by one. Tap "Next" to see the next place to tap
- Each step is read aloud (you can turn this off)
- Tap the screenshot to zoom in

CONTINUE ON THE NEXT SCREEN
When the screen changes, show a screenshot of the new screen. The app remembers what you want to do and continues from there.

CAUTION ON SUSPICIOUS SCREENS
Screens that ask for money or a PIN, or fake virus warnings, are marked with a "Caution" note. If you are not sure, ask your family before you tap.

SEND TO FAMILY
Send the picture with the circles to your family in a messaging app and talk it through together.

LOOK BACK AT PAST GUIDES
Guides are saved on your phone, and you can add memos.

EASY TO START
A short welcome guide lets you practice taking a screenshot and tapping the red circle.

EASY TO SEE AND TAP
- Large text, strong contrast, and big buttons
- Follows your phone's text size setting

PRICE
A plan is needed to use the app.
- Yearly plan: JPY 7,800 (the first 7 days are free)
- Monthly plan: JPY 980
- You can ask up to 100 times a day
- Plans renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Cancel anytime in Settings > your name > Subscriptions
- If you cancel during the free trial, you will not be charged
- Family Sharing is not supported

Terms of Use: https://kokoboshi-jp.web.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://kokoboshi-jp.web.app/privacy

PRIVACY
Screenshots are sent to AI (Claude by Anthropic) only to work out where to tap, and are not stored on our server. Please do not show screens with a PIN, a password, or a card number.
Your saved guides stay only on your phone.

Note: The AI can make mistakes. If something seems wrong, stop and ask your family before you tap.

6830175143.name: As I See You
6830175143.description:
"My girlfriend, as I see her." "My best friend, as I see them."
Make the trending 3x3 picture where you describe someone through nine topics and fill each square with a photo — right on your phone.

- Fill nine squares with photos
Animal, place, plant, character, season, hobby, food, color, drink.
"If this person were an animal, what would they be?" Fill each square with a photo from your camera roll. Images you find on Pinterest work too — just save them to Photos first.

- Fill the color square with a color
Instead of a photo, you can paint a square with a single color.

- Position and size
Pinch to zoom and drag to move, so the part you want shows in the square.

- Remove the background
Cut out just the person or object and place it on white — perfect for the character square. The original photo is kept, so you can bring the background back anytime.

- A title in the center
Pick a title like "My dad, as I see him" or write your own.

- Make your own topic sets
Choose your own nine topics and save them as a set to use again and again.

- Export as a pair
Export the finished image (3:4) together with the blank topic sheet. Save them to Photos or send them in your story or a chat.
Empty squares show the topic in white on black, so even an unfinished board looks good.

- Your photos stay on your device
The photos you pick and your boards are stored only on this device. They are never sent to a server.

Partner, friends, family, your fave. Turn the time you spend thinking about someone into one picture.

■ Terms of Use & Privacy Policy
Terms of Use: https://tsuzukit.com/asiseeyou/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://tsuzukit.com/asiseeyou/privacy.html

6835219829.name: Kakitsuke: Invoice & Estimate
6835219829.description:
Kakitsuke makes estimates, delivery notes, invoices and receipts for freelancers and small businesses in Japan. Create all four documents from the same line items and send them as A4 PDFs in the format of Japan's qualified invoice system.

FOUR DOCUMENTS FROM THE SAME ITEMS
- Turn an estimate into a delivery note, an invoice and a receipt with one tap
- Monthly invoices: pick a client and a month to combine that month's delivery notes into one invoice

JAPAN'S QUALIFIED INVOICE FORMAT
- Your registration number (T + 13 digits) on the document
- Totals and consumption tax for each rate (10% and the reduced 8%), with reduced-rate items marked
- Tax is rounded once per rate per document (round down, round off or round up)
- Tax-excluded or tax-included prices

WITHHOLDING TAX
- Turn on withholding for a document to calculate 10.21% (20.42% on the part over 1 million yen) and show the amount due

A4 LAYOUT THAT STAYS PUT
- Fixed column widths; long names wrap inside their cells
- Long documents continue neatly on page 2
- Section headings and subtotals, discounts and text-only lines
- Standard, window envelope and simple layouts
- Logo and seal (with the background removed from a photo), bank details, due date and notes

YOUR DATA STAYS SAFE
- Sync between iPhone and iPad with iCloud (same Apple Account)
- Automatic daily backups kept for 30 days; restore any day
- Export and import backup files; deleted documents stay in Trash for 30 days

CLIENTS AND ITEMS
- Import clients from Contacts; search and sort
- Items with unit, price, tax rate and category

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
- One-time purchase with every feature included. No in-app purchases, subscriptions or ads
- No account and no sign-in. Documents are stored on your device and in your own iCloud
- On iPad and iPhone Duo, the list and the document preview sit side by side
- English and Japanese, for the app and for the documents. Amounts are in yen

Tax calculations follow the guidance of Japan's National Tax Agency. Please check with a tax professional for your own situation.

Help: https://kakitsuke.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6835219994.name: Fumibako: Japanese Address
6835219994.description:
Print Japanese addresses vertically on postcards and envelopes: New Year cards (nengajo), mourning postcards, thank-you letters and business mail. Keep one address book, choose the paper first, and print exactly what the full-size preview shows. No ads, no account, no network.

PAPER FIRST
- Postcard, reply-paid postcard, Naga 3, Naga 4, Kaku 2 and You 2 envelopes
- The preview is the real paper shape; printing and PDF use the same drawing, so sizes never drift
- Prints to any AirPrint printer with the paper size set

CLEAN VERTICAL ADDRESSES
- Block and room numbers in kanji numerals
- Up to three joint names, sharing one family name, aligned at the bottom
- Font size fits the name and address length so nothing overflows
- Company, department and contact person; honorifics Sama, Onchu, Sensei, Dono or none

POSTAL CODES
- Type a postal code and the address appears, from Japan Post's postal code data stored on the device (no network)
- Postal-code boxes start from Japan Post's published dimensions; fine-tune per paper in 0.5 mm steps
- Test print on plain paper and lay the postcard over it

ADDRESS BOOK
- Groups and search
- This year's marks: sent, received, in mourning
- Add from Contacts or import CSV
- Several senders (family, work); choose whether to print the sender

KEEP IT SAFE
- Daily backups to iCloud Drive (30 days, restore any day)
- Export a backup file or CSV; trash for deleted entries

One purchase unlocks everything. No in-app purchases, subscriptions or ads. On iPad and iPhone Duo, the address book and preview sit side by side. Japanese and English screens; the address side is always Japanese vertical writing.

Help: https://fumibako.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6835219847.name: Minoue: Japanese Resume Maker
6835219847.description:
Minoue makes Japanese resumes (rirekisho), career history documents (shokumu keirekisho) and cover letters as PDFs. There is no account, no sign-in and no network connection, so your personal information never leaves your device.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account or sign-in. The app makes no network connections
- Everything stays on your device (and in your own iCloud backups)
- No ads, and no ads to watch before saving or exporting

THE HARD PARTS, DONE FOR YOU
- Enter your birthday and the months and years you entered and graduated from each school are listed
- Your age is calculated from the document date
- Switch the whole document between Western years and Japanese eras (Showa, Heisei, Reiwa)
- Choose wording such as expected to graduate, high school equivalency, currently enrolled and more

ONE PROFILE, MANY APPLICATIONS
- Enter your profile, education and work history once
- Change the reason for applying, self-promotion, requests, layout and paper size for each company
- Duplicate to apply to another company

PHOTOS
- Crop your own photo to resume size (30 x 40 mm and more)
- Change the background to white, light blue or light gray

DOCUMENTS
- A layout following the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare's example (gender optional, no commute or dependents fields), plus general and part-time layouts
- PDFs in A4 x 2, A3, B5 x 2 and B4. The preview and the PDF use the same drawing, so nothing shifts
- Career history (chronological, reverse chronological or by role) and cover letters

KEEP YOUR DATA SAFE
- Daily backups to iCloud Drive for 30 days; restore any day
- Export and import backup files, and a Trash

One-time purchase with every feature included. No in-app purchases, subscriptions or ads. On iPad and iPhone Duo, the form and the preview sit side by side. English and Japanese screens; the documents follow the Japanese format and are in Japanese.

Help: https://minoue.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6833698631.name: Umashikate: Food Diary Camera
6833698631.description:
Before you eat, and after. Two photos are all it takes to keep a record of every good meal.

■ Before and after, in one card
Take one photo before you dig in and one after you finish. They become a single card you can share right away. When you take the after photo, the before photo is faintly overlaid so you can match the framing.

■ Everything you eat piles up in the stomach
Each dish is cut out of your photo and turned into a sticker. When you finish a meal, it drops into the pink stomach on your Home screen. Tilt your iPhone and the dishes roll around. Grab one with a finger to toss it, or press and hold to make it bigger.

■ Course meals and forgotten shots
For courses, izakaya or barbecue where plates keep coming, just add each dish as it arrives. If you forget the after photo, the before photo still keeps the record.

■ Look back with a calendar and a food guide
Days you ate show the dish photos on a calendar. Add a place, and each Japanese prefecture you ate in fills a square in your food guide.

■ Your records stay on your iPhone
No account needed. Photos and records are never sent to the developer's servers. Dish recognition and cut-outs happen on your iPhone.

■ Umashikate+ (lifetime or weekly)
- No ads
- iCloud photo backup (restoring is free for everyone)
- All filters (Toasty, Fresh, Sweet)
- Make your own dish emoji
- A map of where you ate
- Themes for the stomach and the app icon

The weekly plan renews automatically every week. It renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends, and is charged to your Apple Account. Cancel in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions on your iPhone.

Terms of Use: https://tsuzukit.com/umashikate/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://tsuzukit.com/umashikate/privacy.html

6835219375.name: Blink Anzan: Flash Mental Math
6835219375.description:
Numbers flash by in the blink of an eye. Add up everything you saw and enter the total. Blink Anzan turns the flash mental math (flash anzan) and listening drills used in soroban classes into a 5-minute daily practice.

- Timed to your seconds
The span from the first number appearing to the last one disappearing is set to the seconds you choose. Each frame shows the number due at that moment, counted from the start, so delays don't build up. The answer screen shows the time it actually took.

- 60 steps that get faster
Flash has 60 steps, from 1 digit, 3 numbers, 5 s up to 3 digits, 15 numbers, 1.5 s. Listening has 24 steps. Get 4 of 5 (or 8 of 10) right to move on. Mistakes never move you down, and you can start at any step.

- Skill check first
Try one slow problem, then a 5-problem skill check that gets faster. It stops at your first miss and picks the step that fits you.

- My drills for exams and contests
Choose digits (1-6), numbers (2-30), seconds (1.0-60.0) and whether to mix in subtraction, then save it with a name. Practice the exact conditions of your exam or contest every day.

- Listening drill
Numbers are read aloud one by one, abacus-class style, at slow, normal or fast speed.

- Keeps going, and lets you review
A round of 5 (or 10) problems runs back to back. Right answers move on automatically. When you miss, you see the full equation and the correct answer, and Watch again replays the same numbers at the same speed. You can also retry a single problem from the summary.

- Big, sharp numbers
Numbers are sized to fill your screen on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo. Choose Night, Day or Chalkboard. Subtracted numbers get a different color and a minus sign.

- Records and charts
Every answer is saved. See correct and wrong answers for the last two weeks and how many steps you've cleared. Records sync with iCloud and stay when you change phones.

- Sounds
A tick for each number and sounds for right and wrong. They play even with the silent switch on, and you can turn them off.

- Shortcuts
Start practice from Siri, Shortcuts or the Action button.

- No ads, no purchases, no account
No tracking or analytics. Your records are never sent to the developer.

This is not an official app of any exam organization. Steps are this app's own levels.

6835044739.name: Tokinaoshi: DS Kentei Quiz
6835044739.description:
Missed questions come back until you get them right.
Tokinaoshi is a multiple-choice practice app for Japan's Data Scientist Certification, Literacy Level (DS Kentei).

IMPORTANT: The questions, answer choices and explanations are written in Japanese, because the exam itself is held in Japanese. The app's menus and buttons are available in English and Japanese.

■ Who it's for
・You bought a practice app and found wrong answers or wrong explanations
・You can't tell whether the questions really cover the whole exam scope
・You want to redo only the questions you missed
・You want to study a little at a time, in 5 minutes on the train or at lunch

■ Retry: missed questions come back on their own
When you miss a question, it goes into your retry queue automatically.
・Once more at the end of the same session
・Once more the next day
・Once more 3 days later
Answer it correctly twice in a row and it's cleared. You never have to mark and collect questions yourself.
Open "Today's Set" and the questions that came back are lined up together with new ones.

■ 474 questions with checked answers
There are 474 questions, each with an explanation.
Every question was solved again, twice, by a separate AI run that never saw the answer key, and the answers matched both times.
If you still find a mistake, you can report it right away from "Report a Mistake in This Question" under the explanation.

■ Covers the whole scope
Each of the 238 apprentice-level (one-star) items in the Skill Checklist ver.6 by The Japan DataScientist Society, plus the topics of the Model Curriculum for Mathematics, Data Science and AI (Literacy Level), has its own questions.
・Foundations
・Value Creation
・Data Science
・Data Engineering
・Model Curriculum
The Coverage screen shows how far you've gotten in each topic. You can also choose a topic and practice it.

■ A mock exam as long as the real one
100 questions in 100 minutes, straight through. Answers and explanations stay hidden until the end.
There is also a short version: 25 questions in 25 minutes.
Results are kept with your accuracy by area. Missed questions go into your retry queue.

■ Easy to use
・Pick an answer and the correct answer and explanation appear right there
・The Next button is always in the same place at the bottom
・You can select and copy the text of questions and explanations
・Search questions and explanations by word
・Flag questions you want to see again
・Set your exam date to see the days remaining; from 7 days before, Home switches to final review
・On supported iPhones, Apple Intelligence can rephrase an explanation in simpler words (it runs on the iPhone)
・Get a reminder on days when missed questions come back (only if you turn it on)

■ Peace of mind
・Every question works offline
・No ads, no in-app purchases, no account
・Your records are saved on your iPhone and in your own iCloud
・The developer collects no data

■ Please note
・This app is an independent practice set made by an individual. It is not affiliated with the exam organizer and is not official study material
・All questions were newly written for this app. They are not questions from past exams
・It does not guarantee that you will pass
・"データサイエンティスト検定" and "DS検定" are trademarks of The Japan DataScientist Society
・Where checklist sentences are shown, they are credited as quoted from the Skill Checklist of The Japan DataScientist Society

Terms of Use: https://tokinaoshi.tsuzukit.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://tokinaoshi.tsuzukit.com/privacy.html

6835219646.name: AkaSheet: Japanese Law Drill
6835219646.description:
Majority or two-thirds? Void, or voidable? In good faith or in bad faith?
AkaSheet is a fill-in-the-blank app for people who lose points on the exact wording of Japanese statutes. It brings the classic study method of writing key words in orange and hiding them with a red sheet to your phone.

The statutes are in Japanese. The menus are in English and Japanese.

15 LAWS, 5,171 ARTICLES IN ONE APP
Core codes: Constitution of Japan, Civil Code, Penal Code, Commercial Code, Companies Act, Code of Civil Procedure, Code of Criminal Procedure
Administrative law: Administrative Procedure Act, Administrative Complaint Review Act, Administrative Case Litigation Act, State Redress Act, Local Autonomy Act
Real estate: Land and Building Lease Act, Act on Building Unit Ownership, Real Estate Brokerage Act
The text comes from e-Gov Law Search (Digital Agency of Japan) as of each law's effective date (Civil Code: 2026-06-24). TsuzuKit edited it: supplementary provisions and appended tables are left out, and blanks and choices are added.

STUDY WITH A RED SHEET
13,965 key words are hidden under red bars. Pick the word the statute uses from four choices. Once you get a blank right, it comes back as a type-in question, because multiple choice can be guessed. Different ways of writing numbers ("3分の2", "2/3") are accepted.
Blanks whose answer appears elsewhere in the same sentence are left out. Wrong choices come from groups of words that can stand in the same place (duties and powers, legal effects, good and bad faith, and so on).

PICK YOUR RANGE, DOWN TO ARTICLES
Start from an exam preset (gyoseishoshi, civil service law, takken real estate, judicial scrivener, bar and preliminary exams, or the Constitution only), then build your own range by law, chapter and article.

REVIEW BEFORE YOU FORGET
Fading articles come first, based on how long ago you last answered and how many times in a row you got it right. Missed blanks go into your mistake notebook and are cleared after three correct answers in a row. When you finish a range, polish your weak chapters.

READ IT LIKE A STATUTE BOOK
Jump back to where you left off in the table of contents. Search by article number or by word, and page through articles across chapters. Five text sizes. Put the red sheet over any article and tap a red bar to reveal just that word.

MAKE YOUR OWN BLANKS WITH MARKERS
Long-press and select a word, tap Add marker, and it becomes a blank the red sheet hides too. Marker blanks are self-graded: flip and choose Remembered or Didn't remember.

RECORDS
Your streak, a 10-week calendar, the last 14 days and progress for each law.

APPLE FEATURES
- Progress, markers, bookmarks and ranges sync through your own iCloud
- Shortcuts and Siri: "Study today's set"
- Spotlight: search an article from the Home Screen and open it
- iPad and iPhone Duo show the table of contents and the article side by side

NOTES
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no account. No connection to any developer server; the only network use is iCloud sync.
- Not affiliated with any exam body or publisher. It does not guarantee exam questions or legal interpretation.

6835104074.name: Hyoyomi - Web Aptitude Test
6835104074.description:
Pick numbers from charts. Calculate before time runs out.
Hyoyomi helps you practice the numerical section of the web aptitude tests used in Japanese job hunting (Tamatebako, GAB, C-GAB): chart reading, reverse arithmetic, and table blanks, at the real test's pace.

The questions and charts are in Japanese, because they prepare you for tests taken in Japanese. The app's screens are in English.

- Built for these problems -
- Wrong answers or explanations: every answer, choice, and explanation is calculated from the chart's numbers with a single formula. Every question is re-solved by a separate checker written apart from the question generator
- Too few questions: 607 chart sets and 3,867 questions in all. No two tables have the same numbers
- No feel for the time limit: while you solve, a bar shows how long you've spent on the current question against the target (and the time left in full-length runs). Results list your time for each question next to the test's target
- Clumsy calculators: a built-in calculator lets you delete one character at a time, keeps a history, and inserts the last answer. Its contents stay when you hide it
- Short explanations: every step of the calculation, with the numbers you need highlighted on the chart, plus an estimation tip
- Retrying only your mistakes: questions you missed or ran out of time on go to Mistakes and leave once you answer them correctly

- Measure your pace first -
Choose your test (Tamatebako / C-GAB, Web-GAB, or Not Sure Yet), solve 3 chart questions, and see your seconds per question next to the test's target.

- Three formats -
- Chart Reading (1,847 questions): tables, bar charts, line charts, stacked share charts, and pairs of tables
- Reverse Arithmetic (1,500 questions): work the equation backward to find the number in the box
- Table Blanks (520 questions): find how the columns relate and work out the missing number

- Today's Set, every day -
One button on Home starts a timed set (10 Chart Reading, 20 Reverse Arithmetic or 8 Table Blanks questions; the format rotates) with an explanation after each answer. Enter your deadline to see the days left; from 2 days before, a full-length run is suggested.

- More -
- Full-length runs with the test's usual number of questions and time
- Charts of your seconds per question and accuracy over time
- Daily reminder with the days left and today's set
- Start Today's Set from Shortcuts or Siri
- On iPhone Duo, unfold it sideways to see the chart on the left and the question and calculator on the right
- Records are saved on your iPhone and in your iCloud

- No ads, no in-app purchases, no account -
One purchase, nothing more to pay. Works offline. The developer collects no data.

- Please note -
- Hyoyomi is an independent practice app made by an individual and is not affiliated with the test provider (SHL-Japan Limited). Questions are generated by calculation from chart data and are not actual test questions. All figures are fictional, for practice only
- The number of questions and time on the real test can vary by company and test format

Help and contact: https://hyoyomi.tsuzukit.com/
Terms of Use: https://hyoyomi.tsuzukit.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://hyoyomi.tsuzukit.com/privacy.html

6835219661.name: AnatomyTouch: Japanese Anatomy
6835219661.description:
Where is LI4? Where does the biceps brachii originate? Where is the inferior angle of the scapula?
AnatomyTouch is a study app where you answer by tapping a body figure.

Note: the content (names, readings and location texts) is in Japanese, made for Japanese national exams (acupuncture, judo therapy, physical and occupational therapy, nursing). Buttons and menus are in English.

TAP TO ANSWER
Whole-body figures drawn from 3D anatomy data (Z-Anatomy, based on BodyParts3D), from front, back, left and right, with muscle, bone and acupoint layers. Acupoints are judged by distance and muscles and bones by the part you tap. If you miss, the correct spot is circled in green.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 361 acupoints on 14 meridians, located to match the WHO/WPRO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations (2008)
- Key points: source, connecting, cleft, front-mu, back-shu, five transport, influential, confluence, lower sea and four command points
- 183 muscles with origin, insertion, nerve, segments and action
- 64 bones and 414 bony landmarks shown as spots on the figure

QUESTION TYPES
- Tap the location on the figure
- Name the highlighted muscle or bone or the marked acupoint (multiple choice, then typed once you get it right)
- Origins, insertions, nerves and key points
- Hide and reveal cells of the key point table

DAILY ROUNDS
10, 20 or 30 questions. Items come back just before you'd forget them, based on days since your last answer and your streak. Missed items go into the mistake notebook until you get them right 3 times in a row.

ALSO
Search by name, reading, code (LI4) or English name. Lists by meridian and region. Streaks and progress by layer, synced through your iCloud. Side-by-side layout on iPad and iPhone Duo. With VoiceOver, figure questions switch to text multiple choice.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no account. The only network use is iCloud sync; the developer collects no data.

Not an official app of any exam body, school or publisher. No past exam questions included. For study only; not for treatment or diagnosis.
Figures: based on Z-Anatomy (CC BY-SA 4.0) and BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science (CC BY 4.0). The app's figures are CC BY-SA 4.0.

6834370485.name: Baby Touch - No Ads, Ages 0-2
6834370485.description:
Touch anywhere on the screen and Baby Touch answers with sound, gentle vibration and bright, poppy pictures. Made for little ones from 6 months to 2 years.

No aiming needed. With a finger or a whole hand, the one thing your child touches answers right away. One touch, one response — a clear "I did that!" they can enjoy again and again.

EIGHT GAMES
• Pop Pop – smiley shapes pop out where you touch, with marimba notes (low on the left, high on the right). They bounce and pile up
• Bubbles – touch the rising bubbles to pop them. Some hide a star or heart inside. Hold to blow a big one
• Instruments – drum, bell, maracas and xylophone. Each xylophone tap plays the next note of "Twinkle Twinkle", "Mary Had a Little Lamb", "The Frogs' Chorus" or "London Bridge"
• Vehicles – planes, helicopters and a hot-air balloon in the sky, a steam train and a bullet train on the rails, cars, a bus, ambulance, fire truck, police car and dump truck on the road
• Fireworks – rings, hearts, stars, flowers, cats and smiley faces, plus golden willow fireworks, with a big rumble
• Peekaboo – bear, cat, rabbit, panda, pig, dog, chick, frog, elephant and lion say "boo!"
• Under the Sea – fish, a puffer fish, octopus, jellyfish, turtle and crab appear. Only the one you touch turns around to answer
• Eggs – touch an egg three times and a baby chick, penguin, dinosaur or turtle hatches

After a minute with one game, the app moves on to the next one during a pause. Choose In order, Shuffle or Don't switch.

FOR GROWN-UPS
• No ads, no in-app purchases — one purchase
• No internet connection. Works in Airplane Mode
• Collects no data, no account
• No full-screen flashing; volume peaks are limited
• No text or buttons on the child's screen

GROWN-UPS MENU (hold the lock button at the top right for 3 seconds)
• Choose a game and how games switch (Don't switch, In order, Shuffle)
• Volume (off, soft, medium, loud) and vibration on/off
• Play timer (5–30 min): when time is up, the screen slowly turns to night, a music box plays and it ends with "Good night" — no need to take the iPhone away

To keep little hands in the app, we recommend iOS Guided Access (Settings → Accessibility).

Note: sounds play even in Silent Mode. Choose "Off" in the grown-ups menu to mute.
Please supervise young children while they play.

6834944820.name: Fukuwarai - A Face-Building Party Game
6834944820.description:
Fukuwarai, the classic New Year's game, on a single phone. Place the eyes, nose, mouth and eyebrows on a blank board with your finger. The person placing them can't see the outline of the face or anything they've already placed. When everything is down, it's the big reveal. Look at the face you made and laugh together.

[How to play]
1. Pick a face and tap Start
2. Place the eyes, nose, mouth and eyebrows one at a time. Each part lands where you lift your finger, but the outline and the placed parts stay hidden
3. When everything is placed, reveal it. You also get a score for how close it is to the model
4. Pass it to the next player. At the end, everyone's faces are lined up

[Four faces]
- Okame
- Hyottoko
- Sheep
- Cat
Gentle faces that small children understand. The next player can pick a different one.

[Made for families]
- No time limit. One touch and release places a part
- Made a mistake? Undo one step
- The part you're placing is shown as a big picture, so kids who can't read yet can play
- Choose the blindfold mode and the face and placed parts appear on screen. The player closes their eyes while everyone else watches and calls out "more to the right!"
- At the end, the most similar face and the silliest face are picked
- You can also play alone

[AI scores and comments]
On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, each face gets a fun score and a one-line comment. It runs entirely on the iPhone, so the pictures and comments are never sent over the internet. On other iPhones you can still play with the similarity score.

[Every face is saved]
Finished faces are saved with their scores and comments. You can look back at them, share them, or save them to Photos.

[On a foldable iPhone]
Open an iPhone Duo and stand it like a laptop, and the face being made automatically appears on the outer screen so the person across can watch and help. The outer screen display uses a camera feature, so the camera is used only during that time (the video is never viewed or saved). When the phone is closed, the app asks you to open it. Regular iPhones work too.

[Safe to play]
- No ads and no in-app purchases. A one-time purchase
- No login or sign-up
- Finished faces stay on your iPhone. Nothing is sent to the developer

6835033812.name: Squish Paint: Fold & Print Art
6835033812.description:
Remember fold-and-print painting from art class? Squish Paint brings decalcomania to your iPhone. Drop blobs of paint on the paper, fold it in half, rub the back, and open it. The paint squishes, spreads and mixes with its neighbors into a pattern that is the same on both sides. No real paint, no mess.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Pick a color and touch the paper to drop a blob of paint. Hold to make it bigger, or drag to leave a trail
2. Tap Fold to fold the paper in half
3. Rub the back of the folded paper. The paint spreads more where you rub
4. Tap Open to find the same pattern on both sides of the crease

LIKE THE REAL THING
• Overlapping colors mix (yellow + blue = green)
• Paint gathers along the crease and gets darker
• Squished paint shows fine veins, uneven patches and tiny holes where the paper shows through
• After opening, add more paint and fold again to layer
• Eight colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink and black

ON A FOLDABLE IPHONE
On iPhone Duo, the crease of the paper sits on the fold of the phone. Drop your paint, then really close the phone. The outer display becomes the back of the paper, so rub it, open the phone, and your print is there. Folding the paper and folding the phone become one motion. On regular iPhones, the Fold and Open buttons play the same way.

A TITLE, A SCORE AND AN IMPRESSION
On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, each picture is looked at as a work of art and gets a title, a score and a short impression. It runs entirely on your iPhone, so your picture is never sent anywhere. On other iPhones, the picture is simply kept.

YOUR ARTWORKS ARE KEPT
Finished pictures are kept with their scores and impressions. Look back at them later, share the picture, score and impression as one image, or save the picture to Photos.

FOR LITTLE KIDS AND GROWN-UPS
• Touch to drop paint, fold, open. There is no way to get it wrong
• Short words, and colors are picked from paint pots
• Undo takes back the last stroke
• Just as satisfying for adults making patterns alone

MADE TO BE SAFE
• One-time purchase with no ads and no in-app purchases
• No login and no account
• Your pictures stay on your iPhone and are never sent to the developer
• Available in English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese

6834370201.name: Oekaki Atekko - Drawing Guessing Game
6834370201.description:
Only the artist knows the prompt and draws it without saying a word. Everyone else looks at the drawing and guesses what it is. A drawing and guessing game for family and friends, played by passing one phone around.

[How to play]
1. The artist picks one of three prompt cards (no peeking for everyone else)
2. Draw it within the time limit without speaking. Forgot the prompt? Hold the button to see it
3. Everyone guesses out loud. When someone gets it, tap Got it!

[Made for playing with kids]
- Only prompts kids know: food, animals, vehicles, characters and more, about 440 in 9 groups
- Words use only hiragana and katakana, and each card has an emoji hint, so kids who can't read yet can draw too
- Two levels: Easy (names of things only) and Normal (places, jobs and events too)
- Rounds of 30, 60 or 90 seconds, or no time limit
- 10 crayon colors, 3 line widths, an eraser and undo

[Two ways to play]
- Everyone: take turns drawing and guess together, counting correct answers
- Two teams: the Rabbit team and the Bear team take turns drawing. First to 3, 5 or 10 points wins

[Save your drawings]
At the end of the game, the day's drawings are lined up. You can save them all to Photos.

[On a foldable iPhone]
Open an iPhone Duo and stand it like a laptop, and the drawing automatically appears on the outer screen so the people across can watch and guess. The outer screen display uses a camera feature, so the camera is used only during that time (the video is never viewed or saved). When the phone is closed, the app asks you to open it.

[Safe to play]
- No ads and no in-app purchases. A one-time purchase
- No login or sign-up
- Drawings stay on your iPhone. Nothing is sent to the developer

Character names that appear in prompts belong to their respective owners. This app is not affiliated with them.

6832391789.name: LED Scroller: Scrolling Text
6832391789.description:
Turn your phone sideways and scroll your message like a real LED sign.
Hold it up at a concert, tell a driver their headlights are off, or greet someone at the airport — in letters big enough to read from far away.

■ Open it and play
The first screen is the text field. Type, tap Play, and your message scrolls full-screen in landscape. No sign-up.

■ Sharp characters, even complex ones
Most LED banner apps draw text with coarse on/off dots, which blurs detailed characters. This app uses about 28 dots per letter and dims each dot by how much of the stroke it covers, so complex Japanese, Chinese, and Korean characters stay readable.
Still messages wrap automatically and use a finer grid when they get long.

■ Made for switching at concerts
Your messages glow on the home screen, ready to go. Tap one to play it, then swipe left or right to switch to the next. The order never changes while you play, so you can follow your plan in a dark venue.

■ Make it yours
• Colors: red, orange, yellow, lime, green, sky blue, blue, purple, pink, white, rainbow
• Motion: scroll or still
• Speed and blinking
• Dot size: large, normal, fine
• Font: sans or rounded

■ Great for
• Concerts and fan signs
• Telling a driver "Your headlights are off"
• Thanking a driver who let you in
• Airport and station pickup signs
• Quiet places like hospitals and front desks
• Birthday surprises

■ While playing
• Switches to full-screen landscape automatically
• Keeps the screen awake at full brightness (you can turn this off)
• Pause, change the speed, or move between messages

Your messages are saved only on this iPhone.

Note: Some venues don't allow light-up items. Please follow the venue's rules.

Terms of Use: https://tsuzukit.com/ledbanner/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://tsuzukit.com/ledbanner/privacy.html

6835220137.name: Jindori: Tactics Board
6835220137.description:
Place players and the ball on a court, draw the movement with arrows, and chain steps to show the play. Pick the sport inside one app. No ads, no account, no extra purchases.

■ Sports and courts (10 sports, 15 courts)
- Soccer (11v11, 8v8), futsal
- Basketball (full and half court)
- Volleyball (6-a-side, 9-a-side men / women)
- Handball, rugby (15s, 7s), field hockey, water polo
- Baseball, softball
Court lines are drawn from each sport's official rule dimensions.

■ Any number of players, any number
- Start with the usual line-up for the sport
- Add or remove players any time (even if your team has only 10)
- Type the jersey number; duplicates are allowed
- Home and away teams, each with a name, a color and player names

■ Draw the movement
- Drag players with your finger
- Five kinds of lines: run, pass, dribble, plain line and zone, in three widths and several colors
- A drawn line is one straight line from start to end; pinch the middle to bend it
- Undo and redo

■ Chain steps and show them
- A new step starts from the previous line-up
- Play it back and players and the ball move from step to step (adjustable speed)
- Share as a video (mp4), an image or a PDF
- Landscape and iPad show a bigger court; an external display (AirPlay or cable) shows only the court

■ Your data
- Plays and teams stay the same on iPhone and iPad with iCloud
- Daily backups and a 30-day trash
- The only network use is iCloud. No developer servers, no analytics

Support: https://jindori.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6835219852.name: Yomikake: Japanese Classics
6835219852.description:
Read public-domain Japanese literature from Aozora Bunko in vertical type, like a printed book. Ruby (furigana), emphasis dots and upright numbers are laid out, and the app always opens on the page you were reading. No ads, no account, no extra purchases.

BUILT IN
- 579 popular works (I Am a Cat, Run, Melos!, Kokoro, Night on the Galactic Railroad, Rashomon and more) are in the app and open offline
- Search about 17,000 more works by title, author or reading; they download from Aozora Bunko when you open them and stay on your device

VERTICAL LAYOUT
- Ruby beside the characters, emphasis dots, upright numbers, indents and headings
- Old characters written as notes are converted to real characters where Unicode has them
- Choose text size, Mincho or Gothic, line spacing, margins and paper color (white, cream, dark)
- Vertical mode reads right to left, like a Japanese book; switch to horizontal anytime

CONTINUE READING
- Opens on the page you were reading
- Bookmarks with a note, as many as you like
- iCloud keeps your place, bookmarks and favorites the same on iPhone and iPad (the texts are not uploaded)

READ ALOUD
- Uses your device's voice and reads words with ruby by their ruby reading; the current line is highlighted
- Keeps reading with the screen off

IPAD AND IPHONE DUO
- Two-page spreads on wide screens

DATA
- The only network access is downloading texts from Aozora Bunko. No server of ours, no analytics, no ads

ABOUT AOZORA BUNKO
- The works are files from Aozora Bunko (https://www.aozora.gr.jp/), limited to works whose copyright has expired. The source edition, input and proofreading credits are kept on the last page of each book
- This app is not an official Aozora Bunko app

Contact: https://yomikake.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6835219920.name: Tojishiro: Comic Reader
6835219920.description:
A reader for your own comic files (zip, cbz, rar, cbr, 7z, cb7, pdf and image folders). Pick one folder and it becomes a bookshelf with series and volumes grouped automatically. No ads, no account, no extra purchases.

JUST PICK A FOLDER
- Use a folder from a NAS (SMB share), iCloud Drive or a cloud provider connected in the Files app
- Files are read only when you open them, not copied to your device
- No transfer software needed

SERIES AND VOLUMES, GROUPED
- File names like "Title 01.zip", "Title vol.2.cbz" or "[Author] Title v03" are grouped by series in volume order
- Rename a series or move a volume when the grouping is wrong

RIGHT-TO-LEFT SPREADS
- Right-to-left by default for Japanese manga; switch to left-to-right per series
- Two-page spreads in landscape, on iPad and on iPhone Duo; the cover stands alone and wide images show as one
- Shift by one page if spreads are off

LIGHT AND STABLE
- Only nearby pages are read and thumbnails are cached, so even large zips are never fully extracted

CONTINUE READING
- Opens where you stopped; go on to the next volume at the end
- iCloud keeps your page and binding the same on iPhone and iPad

DATA
- No network access (except iCloud). No server of ours, no analytics, no ads

Contact: https://tojishiro.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6835220028.name: Okidokoro: Room Layout
6835220028.description:
Place furniture on your floor plan at real size (in mm) and check whether it fits. No limits on saving, furniture or rooms. No ads, no account, no extra purchases.

■ Import your floor plan
- Import a photo or PDF of a floor plan, pick two points and enter the real length to set the scale
- Straighten a photo taken at an angle by matching its four corners
- No plan? Enter the room's width and length in mm

■ See at a glance whether it fits
- Clearances to walls and other furniture, in numbers
- Overlaps and anything outside the room in red; walkways narrower than 60 cm in yellow (adjustable)
- Door swings are drawn, with a warning when furniture is in the way
- Tap two points to measure a length

■ Move things the way you want
- Snap to walls and furniture edges (can be turned off)
- Nudge 1 cm at a time with arrows (1 mm with a long press)
- Rotate by 90° or freely
- Type width, depth, position and angle

■ Furniture
- Pick from typical sizes for beds, sofas, tables, bookshelves and more (all editable)
- Make your own with width, depth and height; rectangle, circle or L shape

■ Compare layout ideas
- Make as many layouts as you like for one floor plan
- Compare two layouts side by side

■ Nothing gets lost
- Saved every time you move something
- Daily backups and a 30-day trash
- Floor plans stay the same on iPhone and iPad with iCloud
- Image, PDF (to scale) and print

The only network use is iCloud; it works offline.

Support: https://okidokoro.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6835220140.name: Parapara: Flipbook Animation
6835220140.description:
A flipbook where you draw one frame at a time and play it back right away. No frame limit. No ads, no account, no extra purchases and no posting community. Use your animations however you like.

■ Draw
- Pencil, pen, marker, eraser and fill. Width and color are remembered even after you close the app
- Apple Pencil pressure
- Three layers per frame (sketch, lines, color). The sketch layer isn't exported
- Pinch with two fingers to zoom, two-finger tap to undo, three-finger tap to redo

■ See the frames around it
- The previous frame (reddish) and the next frame (bluish) show through faintly, so you can move things a little at a time
- Choose how many frames to show

■ Fills that don't leak
- Fill stops at the lines of all visible layers
- Small gaps in a line don't let the fill escape (adjust the gap size in Settings)

■ Play and export
- 1 to 30 frames per second; hold any frame for longer
- Loop or ping-pong
- Export as GIF, video (mp4) or numbered PNG images and send them anywhere

■ Your data
- No limits on frames or flipbooks
- Saved after every stroke, with a 30-day trash
- Flipbooks stay the same on iPhone and iPad with iCloud
- The only network use is iCloud

Support: https://parapara.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6835220175.name: Itakiri: Cut List Optimizer
6835220175.description:
Enter the parts for your DIY project and get a layout that cuts them from standard sheets (plywood, MDF) or lengths (2x4, square timber, pipe) with less material. The diagram, with cut order numbers and sizes, can be shown as-is at a store's cutting desk. No ads, no account, no extra purchases.

■ Sheets (plywood, MDF)
- Only straight edge-to-edge cuts, the kind a panel saw can make
- Lock the grain direction per part (rotatable parts are turned 90° when needed)
- Blade kerf and edge trim are included

■ Lengths (2x4, timber, pipe)
- Parts are cut from standard lengths, longest first
- A part that matches the full length is used without a cut

■ Use your offcuts first
- Enter offcut sizes and counts and they're used before new stock

■ A diagram to show the shop
- Per board: part names and sizes, numbered cut order and leftovers
- A large, high-contrast diagram as PDF, image or print
- Parts that don't fit come with a reason: larger than the board, or blocked by grain direction

■ Material and cutting costs
- Enter stock prices and the price per cut to see the total from the number of boards and cuts (you enter the prices)

■ Your data
- Projects stay the same on iPhone and iPad with iCloud
- The only network use is iCloud

Support: https://itakiri.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6835219885.name: Tsugime: Long Screenshot
6835219885.description:
Take a few overlapping screenshots while you scroll. Tsugime finds where they overlap and joins them into one seamless image, kept at full size so text stays readable. No ads, no account and no in-app purchases.

STITCH BY PICKING
- Tap Choose Screenshots and pick them from top to bottom. They are placed in the order you pick
- Overlaps between neighbors are found automatically and a preview appears, with each seam marked
- When no overlap is found, the next screenshot is added below

BARS APPEAR ONCE
- Bars that sit in the same place on every screenshot, like navigation and tab bars, are removed from the second screenshot on
- Turn this off to keep every bar

FIX A SEAM BY 1 PX
- Adjust the overlap of each seam with -1 and +1, or go back to Auto
- Move screenshots up or down, remove them or add more later

SAVE FULL SIZE
- Images are never shrunk. PNG keeps text crisp (JPEG is also available)
- Very tall images are split every 8,192, 16,384 or 32,768 px
- Save to Photos or share. If saving fails, you see why and can save again

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No internet. Screenshots and images stay on your device
- Screenshots are picked in the system photo picker, so no photo library read permission is needed. Add-only permission is asked when you save
- Your images stay in a list so you can reopen and fix them later

GREAT FOR
- Long articles, recipes, chat threads and settings screens you want to send or keep as one image

Works on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo (open it to see the preview and controls side by side). Japanese and English.

Terms of Use: https://tsugime.tsuzukit.com/terms.html

6835220286.name: Torikiri: Film Camera
6835220286.description:
Pick a roll of film and shoot 12, 24 or 36 shots; when the roll is finished, it's developed. Eight film looks made for this app. No ads, no account, no extra purchases.

■ Shoot the roll, then wait
- Pick a film and roll length and start shooting. Shots left are always shown
- Finish the roll or tap Develop Now. Develop now, in an hour or tomorrow morning
- Developed photos are saved to Photos; if saving fails, you'll see why

■ Eight films
- Seaside, Dusk, After School, After Rain, Café, Summer Break, Winter Morning, Sumi (black and white)
- Grain, vignette, light leaks and an optional date stamp

■ Stays cool
- The viewfinder only does a light color change; grain and other effects go on the shot photo only
- The camera stops when you leave the app

■ Your existing photos too
- Pick a photo from Photos and apply a film's color and grain

■ And more
- 0.5x, 1x and 2x (lenses your device has), flash, self-timer
- Choose whether to keep location (off by default)
- Each developed roll becomes an album; iPhone and iPad stay the same with iCloud
- The only network use is iCloud

Note: In Japan, the camera shutter sound can't be turned off.

Support: https://torikiri.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6835219913.name: Shitatame: Tategaki Editor
6835219913.description:
Shitatame is an editor for writing Japanese novels and manuscripts in vertical text (tategaki). Text is laid out vertically as you type, and ruby (reading aids) and emphasis dots appear beside the characters using the same plain-text marks Japanese fiction posting sites use. It always shows how many sheets of 400-character manuscript paper you have filled, and exports manuscript-paper PDFs for contests and plain text you can paste into posting sites. No ads, no account, no extra purchases.

WRITE VERTICALLY
- Type directly in vertical text; characters being converted also run vertically
- Switch to horizontal text at any time
- Two-digit numbers (12, !?) are set upright automatically
- Arrow keys on an external keyboard work too (up and down move along a line, left and right move between lines)

RUBY AND EMPHASIS DOTS
- Ruby is written as ｜base《reading》, or 漢字《かんじ》 for kanji only; emphasis dots as 《《text》》. The marks match posting sites, so pasted text stays intact
- Add ruby or emphasis dots to the selected text from the bar above the keyboard
- A single dash or ellipsis (instead of a pair) is pointed out

CHARACTER AND SHEET COUNT
- See the character count (readings and marks are not counted) and the number of 400-character sheets (20 x 20) at all times
- Line breaks, punctuation and closing brackets kept off the start of a line, and paragraph indents are all counted
- Set a target length to see what is left

WORKS AND CHAPTERS
- Split each work into chapters and reorder them by dragging
- Open notes on characters, setting and plot from the writing screen

NOTHING GETS LOST
- Every character is saved as you type; there is no Save button
- Keep versions of each chapter (by hand, plus one a day for 30 days). Restoring keeps your current text as a version first
- Daily backups are kept for 30 days, and backup files can be exported and imported. Deleted works stay in Trash for 30 days

ICLOUD SYNC
- Signed in to iCloud, your works, chapters and versions stay the same on iPhone and iPad. If edits clash, both texts are kept as versions
- Without iCloud, everything works on the device alone

EXPORT
- Plain text (.txt) or copy for posting sites (marks kept)
- Manuscript-paper PDF (A4 landscape, 20 x 20, vertical, with ruby, title and page numbers)
- A vertical PDF laid out like a paperback

EASY ON THE EYES
- Choose the font (Mincho or Gothic), size, line spacing and paper (white, cream or dark)

IPAD AND IPHONE DUO
- On wide screens, chapters are on the left and the text on the right

DATA
- The only network use is iCloud sync. No server of mine, analytics or ads

The writing itself is Japanese; the interface is in Japanese and English.

Support: https://shitatame.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6835219958.name: Sainome: 3D Dice Roller
6835219958.description:
Real 3D dice that bounce, tumble and settle on the table. From board games to tabletop RPG checks, roll everything in one place.

DICE THAT FEEL REAL
- Dice bounce and roll across felt or wood, then come to rest
- The result is read from how each die lands
- Tap Roll, double-tap the table, or shake your phone
- Choose roll length, sound (wood, felt, cup), silent mode and haptics

HOLD AND REROLL
- Tap a die to hold it; the next roll only rolls the rest. Keep the faces you want

EVERY KIND OF DIE
- d2 (coin), d3, d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20 and d100
- Eight colors and finishes: white, black, wood, red, blue, green, translucent and gold

SETS IN ONE TAP
- Board game, two dice, three dice, five dice, percentile check (1d100), 1d3, 1d10, d20 check, advantage/disadvantage, damage, full polyhedral set and coin
- Make your own sets with any mix of dice, colors and a modifier

MADE FOR TABLETOP RPG
- Roll a formula: type 3d6+2, 1d100 or 2d20
- Percentile checks: enter a target and see Success, Critical or Fumble
- History: time, breakdown and total for your last 300 rolls, plus how many times you rolled today

CUSTOM DICE
- Pick 2 to 12 sides and put text, colors or emoji on each face
- Comes with examples: yes/no, a color die, tonight's dinner and a topic die

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
- One-time purchase with every feature included. No in-app purchases, subscriptions or ads
- No account and no sign-in. No network connections. Your history and sets stay on your device
- On iPad and iPhone Duo, the table and your results sit side by side. English and Japanese

Help: https://sainome.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6762191456.name: SkinLens - AI Skin Analyzer
6762191456.description:
Take a photo of your skin, and SkinLens gives you an AI estimate of its condition along with skincare tips. Every result is saved, so you can watch your score change over time.

WHAT YOU SEE AFTER ONE PHOTO
- Skin type (dry, oily, combination, or normal)
- Skin score (0 to 100)
- Moisture and oil levels
- Areas to care for, such as pores, dullness, or dryness
- An estimated skin age

YOUR SKIN LOG
Each analysis is saved to your log, and a chart at the top shows how your skin score has changed, including the difference from last time.

PREMIUM: YOUR SKINCARE PLAN
- Morning and night routines
- Recommended ingredients
- Diet, lifestyle, and seasonal care tips
- Unlimited analyses
- No ads

The free version includes 2 analyses.

PLEASE NOTE
Works on iPhone and iPad.

Results are AI estimates, not a medical diagnosis. If redness, itching, or pain continues, please see a dermatologist.

The free version shows ads (a banner and an ad at launch). Premium removes them.

LEGAL
Privacy Policy: https://tsuzukit.com/legal/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service: https://tsuzukit.com/legal/terms-of-service.html
Commercial Transaction Act: https://tsuzukit.com/legal/commercial-law.html
Disclaimer: https://tsuzukit.com/legal/disclaimer.html

6762191608.name: CloudLens - Cloud AI Guide
6762191608.description:
Snap a photo of the sky, and CloudLens tells you which of the ten cloud genera you are looking at, plus a hint about the weather ahead.

WHAT YOU SEE AFTER ONE PHOTO
- The cloud genus, plus up to 5 close candidates, each with a confidence score
- Whether it is a high, middle, or low cloud

THE WEATHER AHEAD
The top of every result shows what the cloud suggests about the coming weather. If it is a sign of rain, CloudLens tells you an umbrella would be a good idea. This is an estimate from the sky, so check the forecast too before you head out.

A NUMBERED GUIDE TO FILL
The app includes a numbered guide of 60 clouds. Every cloud you identify fills its numbered slot with your own photo. Species you have not found yet show their names faintly, so you know what to look for next. Each guide page has a short description plus altitude and weather sign. 6835220439.name: Jibundayori: Affirmation Voice

6835220311.name: Otomaki: Mixtape Cassette

6835220093.name: Hakaridoki: BP & Weight Log

• Import blood pressure and weight from Apple Health (read only), so readings your monitor or scale apps saved there don't need typing twice
• Export and import CSV

■ What we're careful about
• This app is a notebook, not a measuring device. It never labels readings as high or normal and gives no advice. Talk to your doctor about anything that concerns you
• Readings stay on your device and are never sent anywhere. Deleted readings can be restored from Trash for 30 days

6835219952.name: Masuutsushi: Drawing Grid

6835219737.name: QueueBell: Queue & Waitlist
6835219737.description:
At a busy front desk you tear paper tickets, write numbers on a whiteboard and call them out loud.
QueueBell replaces all of that with one phone: hand out a number, call the next guest, skip anyone who didn't show. Your guests see "Now serving" in big numbers on a nearby iPad, a spare iPhone or a TV.

START RIGHT AWAY
- No account and no sign-in
- Just name your shop and choose how many counters you have
- The first time you open the app, hand out one ticket and call it right there

HAND OUT AND CALL
- Numbers go up in order. Set the first number and an optional letter (A–Z)
- Add a name and party size if you like
- "Call next" on each counter calls the first guest in line
- Call anyone from the line, call again, mark as no-show, or cancel
- Tapped the wrong thing? Undo takes back the last action
- 1 to 10 counters, each with a name and a color

GUEST DISPLAY
- Now serving (per counter), groups waiting, estimated wait, the next numbers and a message from your shop
- Open it on the same device, link a nearby iPad or iPhone, or show it on a TV over AirPlay or HDMI
- Nearby devices link directly, with no server, so it works without the internet
- Devices link only when they share the same 4-digit link code, and the data is encrypted
- The correct numbers always live on the front-desk device; the display only mirrors them and reconnects on its own if the link drops
- The screen stays on while the display is open

CHIME AND VOICE
- A chime plays and a voice announces "Number A 12, please come to counter 1"
- Japanese, English or both. Choose which device speaks: front desk, display or both

WAIT ESTIMATES
- The time per guest comes from how quickly you actually called people, and it updates every time you call
- With two counters, it gets shorter

DAILY RECORDS
- When you close the day, you keep how many were handed out, served, no-shows and cancelled, the average wait and guests per hour
- Guest names are erased when you close the day. Only counts and times are kept

BUILT FOR THE FRONT DESK
- Settings lock (Face ID or passcode), so guests can't change settings
- Six theme colors and Dark Mode
- On iPad and iPhone Duo's wide screen, the current call and the waiting line sit side by side

ONE-TIME PURCHASE
- One purchase unlocks everything. No in-app purchases, no subscription, no ads
- A second iPad or iPhone used as the display needs no extra payment with the same Apple Account
- Your records stay on your device. Nothing reaches the developer

Help: https://yobidashi.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6835219467.name: Tossa: Japanese to English
6835219467.description:
Tossa is a speaking drill for Japanese speakers who can read English but freeze when they try to say it.

Prompts are in Japanese. You turn each Japanese sentence into English and say it out loud.

SEE JAPANESE, SAY ENGLISH, COMPARE
Look at the Japanese sentence and say it in English. Tap Show English to see and hear the model answer, then mark Said it or Missed.
Say it into the mic, and your voice is turned into text on your device and compared with the model. Words we didn't hear are highlighted. Your voice is never saved or sent. On a train, saying it in your head works too.

6 STAGES, 41 PATTERNS, 656 SENTENCES
Sorted by what you want to say, not by school year:
- Sentence basics (be, simple present, third person, there is)
- Time and tense (past, continuous, be going to, will)
- Modals, questions and requests (can, must, should, Could you, How many)
- Comparison, passive, present perfect
- Infinitives, gerunds, participles
- Relative clauses, indirect questions, conjunctions, if
All sentences were written for this app, set in everyday life and work. Other correct ways to say it are shown too.

REVIEW BEFORE YOU FORGET
Missed sentences and ones you said a while ago come first. Then the next pattern. After every pattern, practice them mixed.
Missed sentences go to a notebook until you say them right three times in a row. Skip sentences you already know.

HANDS-FREE LISTENING
Japanese, a pause to think, then English. Choose a 2 to 6 second pause. Keeps playing with the screen off; use the Lock Screen or earphone buttons.

PATTERNS
16 sentences per pattern. Hide the English, say it from the Japanese, and tap to reveal. Star sentences to practice later. Search in Japanese or English.

RECORDS
Streak, the last 14 days, and progress by stage. Progress and stars sync with iCloud across your iPhone and iPad.

NO ADS, NO IN-APP PURCHASES, NO SIGN-UP
One-time purchase. The developer collects no data.

Note: Sentences are read with your device's English voice. Not affiliated with any book, school or test.

6835220345.name: Kokubandori: Site Photo Board
6835220345.description:

6835219794.name: BingoDrum: Caller & Card Maker
6835219794.description:

BingoDrum puts a bingo machine you spin and stop, a big board for the TV, printable cards with instant checks, and prizes into one host's toolkit.

SPIN IT, STOP IT
Tap the big Spin button and the gold drum starts turning. Tap Stop and the ball rolls two or three more times before it drops, then the number is called. No dead stop, no endless wait.
- Choose how long it spins (short, normal, long, or until you stop it)
- Auto-draw with five speeds
- Undo the last ball if you tap by mistake
- Using a real bingo machine? Type the number or tap it on the board

NEVER LOSE YOUR PLACE
Each ball is saved before it's shown. A phone call or closing the app won't lose a single number. Numbers come from your device's secure random generator and never repeat.

BIG ON THE TV
Connect with AirPlay or HDMI and the TV shows a dedicated screen without your controls: the ball, the full board, the last five balls, the reach count and the prizes left, readable from the back of the room. No TV? Use the full-screen display on the same device.

PRINT CARDS AND CHECK BINGOS
- Make PDF cards (4 per A4 page for 75-ball, 6 for 90-ball, up to 500), each with a card number and a card set number. Enter last year's set number to reuse cards you already printed
- Print with AirPrint or share the PDF
- When someone shouts BINGO, enter their card number. The app rebuilds that card, marks the called balls, and shows whether it's complete and on which ball, or how many are still missing

PATTERNS AND BALLS
- 75-ball (with or without B-I-N-G-O letters), 90-ball, or any range from 1 to 999 for raffles: check a winner by the number on their ticket
- One line, two lines, four corners, cross, X, outer frame, blackout, or draw your own

REACH, BINGO, PRIZES
- Count players who are one away and show it on the TV
- A verified bingo gets a fanfare and confetti
- List prizes with names and photos, paste them one per line, reorder them, and keep who won on which ball
- Look back at the results when the game ends

MATCH THE MOOD
Seven TV themes: party, wedding, Christmas, New Year, kids, night sky and simple. Choose how numbers are called ("B 5" or "5") and how fast. Sound effects are made inside the app: a drum roll, the stop, reach and a fanfare.

SAFE FROM STRAY TAPS
Turn on Lock Controls and undoing a ball, ending or deleting a game, and opening Settings all ask for Face ID or your passcode, so you can hand your phone to someone else.

ACTION BUTTON AND SIRI
Add "Spin the Next Ball" and "Repeat the Last Number" to Shortcuts. Your hands are full with the mic and prizes? Press the Action button to spin.

IPAD AND IPHONE DUO
On wide screens, the drum and the board sit side by side.

ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO ADS
Everything is unlocked when you buy. No account, in-app purchases, subscription or ads. The app doesn't use the internet, so it works in venues with poor signal. Games and prizes stay on your device.

The app never handles money or prizes. Please don't use it for gambling.

6756264637.name: Focus Railway
6756264637.description:
Why is it so easy to focus on a train?

Those twenty-odd minutes before your stop. The hum of the rails, the city sliding past. Nothing else to do, and somehow the chapter is finished.
Focus Railway brings that time to your desk, whenever you want it. For studying, working, reading, and getting things done.

■ The gate flips a switch
Open the app and you’re at a station ticket gate. Tap to walk through, climb the stairs, and take your usual seat. That alone is enough to say, “Right, let’s do this.”

■ Your stop becomes your deadline
“To Shibuya” works better than “25 minutes left.” Each station that slides by gets you to push a little further.
If you close the app along the way, the train waits right where you left it. Time spent away doesn’t count as focus time.

■ Look up, and the city is going by
When you get stuck, you look out the window. Lit offices, a train running alongside, people waiting on a platform. You drift for a moment, then come back to the page.
What rolls by is the real Yamanote Line: 30 stations, 34.4 km around, and more than 70,000 buildings along the way, drawn live from map data.

■ A morning commute, or the last train home
Get ready for the day in the morning light. Push a little further in the evening sun. Read quietly on a rainy night.
Rooms light up one by one at night, and raindrops run down the glass on rainy days.

■ The clickety-clack is just right
Silence is a little too quiet. A café is a little too loud. The sound of a running train somehow sits in between.
Rail joints, the door chime, the announcements. None of it is recorded; it’s made on the spot. Play it together with your own music.

■ Arriving feels like a small win
Your focus time, stations, and distance are kept on record. Share them as a station-sign image.

■ Start with one stop (free)
• Tap Ride now to depart from your station without picking a destination
• Focus records and sharing, and Lite Mode for battery and heat
• Ads are shown while you use the app for free (never while the train is moving)

■ Premium
• Choose your stop, and the outer or inner loop
• Choose the window side, time of day, and weather
• Six alternate Home Screen icons
• No ads

Premium is available as monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscriptions, and as a one-time lifetime purchase. See the purchase screen in the app for prices.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel in Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

■ Please note
• Focus Railway is made by an independent developer and is not affiliated with any railway company
• The scenery and travel times differ from the real views and timetables. It can’t be used as a timetable or route planner
• Your focus records are stored only on your device. No account is needed
• Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors
