6835220168.name: Bamiri: Dance Formations
6835220168.description:
Plan dance, cheer and theater formations against the timing of your music. Number the spike marks on the stage, place your members, and set the second and the count at which each formation lands. Play it back and the formations change with the music; share it with your members as a video with the music. No ads, no account, no extra purchases.

■ Never out of sync
- Pick a music file on your device (mp3, m4a, wav, aiff)
- Formations are stored by their position in the song, so the timing never drifts when you reopen
- Enter the BPM and the first beat to place formations on eight-counts (like "3-5")
- Play at 0.5x or 0.75x (same pitch), jump between formations, and loop

■ Stage and spike marks
- Set the stage width, depth and mark spacing (1 m or 90 cm); marks are numbered from center 0
- Members snap to the nearest mark (you can turn it off)
- Select several members to move them together, or mirror left and right
- Bend the path between formations
- Put notes anywhere on the stage for each formation

■ Share with your members
- Video with music (mp4)
- Images of each formation, numbered in order
- A PDF with one page per formation (time, count and notes)

■ Nothing gets lost
- Saved every time you move someone
- Daily backups and a 30-day trash
- Pieces stay the same on iPhone and iPad with iCloud

■ No limits
- Up to 60 members, unlimited pieces
- The only network use is iCloud; it works offline

Note: Use music you have yourself. Follow the rights of the song when you share exported videos. Copy-protected songs from the Music library can't be imported.

Support: https://bamiri.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6835219909.name: Yubigoe: AAC Talk Board
6835219909.description:
When you can't use your voice, Yubigoe speaks for you. Tap a word and your phone says it out loud, right away.

Lost your voice to a cold or after throat or jaw surgery? Living without speech after a laryngectomy, ALS, a stroke or Parkinson's, or finding it hard to speak in some situations? Caring for someone who can't talk? Yubigoe turns one tap into speech.

FOUR WAYS TO SAY IT
- Letter board: big A to Z keys (and a Japanese kana board). It can read each letter as you tap
- Keyboard: type quickly with your device keyboard
- Phrases: about 150 ready-made phrases for replies, greetings, conversation, how you feel, requests, medical visits, shopping, and work and school. Tap to speak. Add your own phrases and the names of the people you call most
- Picture cards: 40 cards for body, things you want, things you need help with, feelings and where it hurts, plus a 0-10 pain scale. Tap "Pain" then "Stomach" and it says "My stomach hurts"

SAY IT RIGHT AWAY
- Yes, No, I don't know and One moment are always on screen and take one tap
- Call plays a chime so people notice you. You can also chime before every message
- Show turns your message into huge text, and Flip turns it around for the person across from you

A VOICE THAT FEELS LIKE YOURS
- Choose any voice on your device, including enhanced voices, and set the speed and pitch
- On iPhone and iPad you can use your own Personal Voice
- Fix words it mispronounces in Pronunciations
- It speaks even with the silent switch on, and through Bluetooth speakers

EASY TO USE
- Large keys, three text sizes and orientation lock
- On iPad and iPhone Duo, the board and your phrases sit side by side
- Say recent messages again in one tap
- English and Japanese

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
- One-time purchase with every feature included. No in-app purchases, subscriptions or ads
- No account and no sign-in. No network connections. Your messages and phrases stay on your device

Yubigoe is not a medical device. In an emergency, use your nurse call button or call emergency services.

Help: https://yubigoe.tsuzukit.com/support.html

6835219962.name: Shuniku: Japanese Hanko Stamp
6835219962.description:
Make Japanese hanko stamps (round, square company, date, oval and word stamps), stamp the PDFs you receive and send them right back. Every export is kept in the Stamp Log. No ads, no account, no network.

STAMP AND SEND BACK
- Open a PDF from Mail or Files and place a stamp; return it from the share sheet
- Before exporting, move, resize, rotate or delete stamps as often as you like, or set the size in mm
- Positions are kept in document coordinates, so the preview and the export match; the document's text stays selectable
- After exporting, reopen the document with its stamps and fix it

MAKE STAMPS
- Round (surname or full name), square company stamp, date stamp, oval and word stamps (Approved, Checked, Received, Paid and more)
- Square stamps fit company names up to 20 characters, choosing rows automatically and never splitting the legal form
- Date stamps fill in the day you stamp (Japanese era or western years)
- Seven typefaces, four ink colors, fading, bleeding and border weight
- Characters a typeface lacks are drawn from another, and you are told which
- Photograph your own hanko pressed on white paper and keep only the ink

STAMP LOG
- Each export adds the date, document, stamp and an optional note
- Search, and export as CSV or PDF

FOR EXCEL AND WORD
- Save or copy any stamp as a transparent PNG at its real size

KEEP IT SAFE
- Daily backups to iCloud Drive (30 days, restore any day)
- Export a backup file; trash for deleted items

One purchase unlocks everything. No in-app purchases, subscriptions or ads, and no feature waits for a review. On iPad and iPhone Duo, your stamps and the document sit side by side. Japanese and English screens; stamps are drawn in Japanese.

Stamps made with this app are not electronic signatures under Japan's Electronic Signature Act. Use them where an everyday hanko would do, such as internal documents and estimates.

Help: https://shuniku.tsuzukit.com/support.html
